import pathlib,json,re,sys,subprocess,math
root=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave165')

def evidence(label,requirements):
 post=json.loads((root/'research/run-logs'/(label+'.postflight.json')).read_text())
 assert post['label']==label and post['source_commit']==SOURCE and post['host_clean'] and post['command_returncode']==0
 assert not post['failures'] and not post['guard_error'] and not post['interrupted_signals']
 raw=(root/'research/run-logs'/(label+'.log')).read_text()
 for req in requirements:
  found=[json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw[m.end():])[0] for m in re.finditer(re.escape(req['marker'])+' ',raw)]
  assert len(found)==req['count'],(label,req['marker'],len(found))
  assert all(all(row.get(k)==v for k,v in req.get('fields',{}).items()) for row in found),(label,req['marker'])
  if 'unique_field' in req:
   values=[row[req['unique_field']] for row in found]
   assert len(values)==len(set(values)) and set(values)==set(req['values'])
  for k,n in req.get('lengths',{}).items(): assert all(len(row[k])==n for row in found)
  if req.get('phase_timing'):
   for row in found:
    assert math.isfinite(row['last_loss']) and all(math.isfinite(x['step_total_ms']) and x['step_total_ms']>0 for x in row['steps'])
 print('ENGINE_MODEL_PREREQUISITE '+json.dumps(dict(label=label,passed=True,source_commit=SOURCE)),flush=True)
